ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is hereby
amended by changing all of the B1-5 Neighborhood Shopping District symbols and indications as
shown on Map 12-C in the area generally bounded by:

a line 95.07 feet north of and parallel to East 55" Street; the public alley next east of and parallel
to South Comell Avenue; East 55" Street; South Cornell Avenue;

To those of a C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect and be in force from and after its passage and due
publication.

Common Address of Property: 5493 South Cornell Avenue
